exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the historical Silent Storm sourcepaint COLOR fragment bitmap into a faithful higher resolution bitmap. This is not a new physical-object rendering and not a test diagram.

Image1 is the EXACT ENTIRE original storedRGB, solely wholecanvas NEAREST enlargement to512 made opaque for color visibility. The source nearest block sampling is UV evidence only: render the same soft subdued sourcepaint shade, not pixelgrid/mosaic/cells. Retain identical complete edge-to-edge normalizedUV, positions/widths/shape/count/nativepaintscale, source SOFT BLUR, dim localcolor hierarchy. No crop, pad, cutout, recenter, framing, fitting or UV repacking. Downstream restores FULL original alpha independently and uses only one global brightness scalar.

ONE original thin upright gently asymmetric muted brown-gray PAINT STRIPE on black. Keep its exact original x/y native phase, narrow width, very dim middle segment, upper patch, lower warmer patch and very small original bottom-right bend. Do not turn it into a shiny rod, metallic edge, wire, straight ruled line, crack, rim or mechanism. Original source is soft, narrow and irregular, not an instruction to regularize it; no new glints, rings, knots or grain.

Actual original nativeRGBA channel extrema are [[0, 76], [0, 53], [0, 55], [0, 255]]; max mean pigment native xy[15, 11] is exact RGBA[76, 53, 55, 255]. Keep these sourceweak relationships and palette, do not replace maxima by255, do not locally brighten white edges or make glinty metal. Black source gaps remain black original shadow. Original Transparent source alpha0..255 is restored downstream; this guide stays opaque to expose storedRGB.

Preserve every weak brown/gray wash and irregular soft tonal patch. Add only subtle finer depiction of EXISTING paint, with no new physical grain, cells, coarse mottle, stipples, cracks, scratches, texture fibers, bevel, rim, shine, plate, ring, knot, wire, flame, rays, spark, cloud or hardware. No new holes/forms/flecks/text/symbols. No photorealistic metallurgy. Output only SAME full opaque RGB square canvas with exact normalizedUV/source material and pattern scale; no border/whitespace/zoom or added objects.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST16x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
